title: Raster Camera As Session-only View Action
description: Move raster plugin's camera/viewport pose out of the document (VCS-tracked) into session-only runtime state, and reclassify setCamera/setCameraZoom actions from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View, so camera changes are no longer undoable/replicated document edits and instead surface as session-only rows in the new universal command-log. Delete RasterOperation::SetCamera and its diff/invert/apply/DSL arms from the op crate entirely (no compat shim). Update UI crate's sync-json / rendering to read camera from runtime state, remove the now-vacuous strip-camera-from-sync-json step and its test, and fix any camera round-trip tests to assert runtime state instead of document state. Prerequisite/sibling work to the separate command-log logging mechanism (not touching that mechanism itself). Crates: ✏️s/🔌️plugin/🖨️raster/🎛️app/🖨️raster/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust (raster doc/projection), .../🔨️module/🔧️op (op crate), .../🔨️module/🖱️ui (ui crate), plus 📡️protocol/🎒️pack/🗣️dsl/⚙️engine modules referencing camera as needed. Verify with cargo check/test per touched package.
summary: Moved the raster plugin's camera pose out of the VCS-tracked document into session-only runtime state and reclassified setCamera/setCameraZoom from ActionKind::Operation to ActionKind::View across the whole raster app crate tree (raster, raster-op, raster-ui, raster-protocol, raster-pack, raster-dsl, raster-engine). Deleted RasterOperation::SetCamera entirely (enum variant, RasterDiff.camera field, diff/absorb/apply/backwards arms, DSL op-text round-trip case) with no compat shim. RasterProjection (the document struct) no longer has a camera field at all; RasterCamera moved to RasterPlayRuntime (ui crate) as the new home for camera state, defaulting via RasterCamera::default(). setCamera/setCameraZoom handlers now write runtime.camera directly and return ActionEmit::default() (empty operations, enforced by the framework's View-kind check). The composite/navigator scene's cameraJson now reads from runtime.camera instead of document.camera. Removed the now-vacuous map.remove(\"camera\") step from document_sync_json and its paired \"sync json must omit camera\" test assertion (trivially true now that camera isn't part of the document). Hand-fixed every RasterProjection struct literal and the semio.raster DSL fixture (dropped its `camera { x=0 y=0 zoom=0.75 }` block) that referenced the removed field, across op/pack/dsl/engine crates. Replaced the op crate's SetCamera-based round-trip/binary tests with equivalent coverage using other operations, and added two new ui-crate tests (set_camera_mutates_runtime_and_emits_no_operations, set_camera_zoom_updates_zoom_and_keeps_pan_via_runtime) asserting the corrected runtime-based behavior. Verified with cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib on all 7 touched packages: semio-s-app-raster (0 tests, clean check), semio-s-app-raster-op (5/5 pass), semio-s-app-raster-protocol (2/2 pass), semio-s-app-raster-pack (2/2 pass), semio-s-app-raster-dsl (2/2 pass), semio-s-app-raster-engine (2/2 pass), semio-s-app-raster-ui (18/20 pass — 2 pre-existing failures confirmed present at HEAD before this change, unrelated: a missing \"brush\" icon catalog entry causes IconName::from(\"brush\") to panic in set_active_utility_switch_emits_no_ops_and_reads_from_view_state and utility_registry_declares_utilities_scoped_to_the_composite_window; flagged as a separate background task rather than fixed here since it's an unrelated icon-catalog gap). Final repo-wide grep for SetCamera/camera-DSL-block confirms zero remaining references in the raster crate tree.
